{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

print("\nColumn dtypes:")
print(data.dtypes)

print("\nUnique values in `channel`:")
print(data['channel'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in `customer_segment`:")
print(data['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nValues in `status`:")
print(data['status'].value_counts())

print("\nValues in `customer_age`:")
print(data['customer_age'].value_counts().head(10))

print("\nUnique values in `revenue`:")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10

# Check for QA test orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA test orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for sentinel -1 in customer_age
sentinel_age = data[data['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {len(sentinel_age)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")"}
